source_reference.title: Unspecified (Mitsunobu etherification of benzyl alcohol with 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde)

reaction.notes: DIAD/PPh3 in dry THF at 0 °C under N2; DIAD added dropwise over 5 min; stirred 1 h until TLC shows full conversion. DIAD added dropwise over 5 min at 0 °C under N2 (separate addition step encoded).

workup.details: Evaporate solvent under reduced pressure to obtain crude oil.
Precipitate product from dichloromethane/petroleum ether mixture; collect white solid.

purification.fractions: Not specified; collect product-containing fractions by TLC.

notes: Reaction monitored by TLC to confirm disappearance of starting materials (~1 h).
Dry THF and inert atmosphere (N2) used.
Product reported as white powder (0.297 g, 76%).

original_procedure:
A solution of benzyl alcohol (0.200 g, 1.85 mmol), 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde (0.226 g, 1.85 mmol), and PPh3(0.582 g, 2.22 mmol) was stirred in dry THF (20 mL) at 0 °C under a nitrogen atmosphere. To this mixture was added dropwise DIAD (0.44 mL, 2.22 mmol) over a period of 5 min, and the reaction was monitored by TLC. After complete disappearance of starting material (1 h), the solvent was evaporated under reduced pressure and the resulting oil purified by flash column chromatography (hexane/AcOEt, 8/2). Phenyl ether (0.297 g, 76%) was finally obtained as a white powder after precipitation from CH2Cl2/petroleum ether. 
Ref:
Renaudet, O; Reymond, J. Org. Lett. 2004, 6, 397.
